excluded_false_positive.instruction_starts: NSSF faini ya kuchelewa ni ngapi
excluded_false_positive.why_kept: TZS 100,000 is the BASE of a worked example of the 5% late-payment penalty (s.14(3), confirmed correct against R.E.2023), not a fine ceiling: 'Mfano: NSSF TZS 100,000 haijalipwa kwa miezi 3 -> faini = 5% x 100,000 x 3 = TZS 15,000'. The rate is statutory and the arithmetic is right.
excluded_false_positive.what_it_demonstrates: A pattern-driven quarantine of the sweep's match set would have deleted a correct row. This is why every row is read before it is removed, and why the exclusion is written down.

_gold_note: Zero. All 13 gold matches on the figure are OSHA's CORRECT TZS 100,000/day continuing-offence charge and are untouched.
